review_plan.claim_under_review: Exact three-cell prime63 m=2 planted outputs have complete raw and phase custody, correct monitor-stop classifications, and independently valid full-point certificates for any cell reported ok. The diagnostic offers no natural-yield, base-ranking or full-cost claim.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: I expect the fixed monitor-null control to fail closed, the independent checker to reject any root or no-solution claim contradicted by the archived witness, and at least one direct m=2 positive to produce an inspectable solver trace within its cap. This is a prior, not an outcome; an unserved review backend or censored solver leaves it unresolved.
review_plan.inference_boundary: Passing review supports only bounded exact m=2 planted solver-to-certificate observations. It does not measure natural decomposition yield, useful rank, linear algebra, held-out target recovery, cold or amortized total cost, matched rho or a best factor base.

joints.attack_plan: Independently enumerate tar members and receipt rows, recompute hashes, reconstruct attempted and unattempted order, and seek missing or duplicated bytes.
joints.breaking_artifact: A named member or schedule row with contradictory bytes, count or hash.
joints.joint: Every scheduled monitor control and positive cell has a unique raw request, trace, stdout, stderr and response when emitted, with exact receipt and archive hashes.

joints.attack_plan: Independently implement field and curve arithmetic from the statement and public parameters, evaluate each polynomial and signed sum, then compare with raw solver statuses.
joints.breaking_artifact: A complete arithmetic counterexample with cell, polynomial or group equation, raw response and witness.
joints.joint: Every accepted planted root satisfies the exact polynomial system, B=475 base and signed full target point; an archived satisfying witness contradicts certified_no_solution.

joints.attack_plan: Recompute terminal classifications from trace, timestamps and resource samples; test whether any early stop was recast as a solver negative or silently skipped.
joints.breaking_artifact: A named cell with raw stop state and reported classification that disagree, or a monitor failure that permitted science.
joints.joint: Monitor fault detection, process-tree RSS, scratch and wall censors are reported within their sampled and watchdog scope.

joints.attack_plan: Build the complete cold and online cost ledger with every unmeasured term null; try to falsify each proposed comparison using missing common-target and matched-rho controls.
joints.breaking_artifact: A quantitative ranking or E2E inference lacking matched natural targets, complete costs or independent rho.
joints.joint: The report makes no factor-base, relation-yield or E2E performance inference from separately planted targets.
